CREATE TABLE trust_credential (
    credential_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
    subject_ref VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
    credential_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
    public_key_pem TEXT NOT NULL, 
    fingerprint_sha256 VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
    issuer_ref VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
    valid_from TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
    valid_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,

    provenance_ref VARCHAR(255),

);

CREATE TABLE signature_record (
    signature_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
    signer_identity_ref VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
    signer_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
    signer_role_ref VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
    authority_ref VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
